description: The notch island (0.1.51): a second window, label `island`, loading the sidecar-served island.html from the same 127.0.0.1 origin as the app. It may report the rectangle it draws (island_shape, so the rest of the window clicks through), ask to bring the main window forward on a conversation (island_open_conversation), and listen for the shell's island-geometry / island-presence / island-pointer / island-main-focus events. Nothing else: no updater, voice, backup, icon or external-link commands, and none of these two are granted to the main window.
